critical_semantics: Every valid within-report deduplicated narrative fragment is classified. DIGITAL_CORE_TERMS only rescues one preliminary noisy-line skip and is not a global digital-keyword prefilter.

specific_plan may set substantive/S=True after earlier v2 exclusions. It does not directly reset digital candidate/C. The later business_purpose and fourth-industrial-revolution checks remain in their original order.
The 48 v2 compiled regexes use IGNORECASE; the 16 v4 compiled regexes do not. Literal company-name substring checks are not made case-insensitive merely by those v2 regex flags.
lower() is used in the within-report deduplication key only. The first retained original fragment, not that lowercased key, is passed to classification.
v4 obtains v2 flags then applies its final vetoes; a positive v2 result does not override a later v4 exclusion.

Public BMODD maps the frozen BMI/bmi fields. NonBMODD is substantive S minus BMODD B, not a separate internal-digitization classifier. Exclude includes non-digital and digital-but-non-substantive fragments.

Loaded splitter.LATIN_RE is statically unreachable from the effective roots and must not be treated as an effective classification trigger. SOURCE_FUNCTIONS_NOT_LOADED lists source presence only, not deployed rules.

Keyword/regex attribution and action checks do not prove real-world execution, semantic coreference, completion of a promise, or causality. Human codebook standards and this approximate Python implementation are distinct.
